posts.text: This week: Gerrymandering continues, the NAACP sues, oral argument over Trump’s executive orders against law firms, & the stay in the Mifepriston case ends tomorrow. Lots to get on top of before the week starts & you can do it all here. open.substack.com/pub/joycev…

Alabama House Speaker Nathaniel Ledbetter called on the courts to overturn the 14th Amendment. Unfortunately, no one followed up to ask him which part he objected to. (Read more here: joycevance.substack.com/p/re… )

The Speaker of the Alabama House wants the courts to overrule the 14th Amendment. Listen to his exact words and understand this: We are seeing the MAGA-faction attack on our elections fully exposed this week. Now is the time to understand that and do something about it. open.substack.com/pub/joycev…
